EIGEN_MAKE_ALIGNED_OPERATOR_NEW expands to EIGEN_MAKE_ALIGNED_OPERATOR_NEW_IF(true); EIGEN_MAKE_ALIGNED_OPERATOR_NEW_IF defines aligned operator new/delete when EIGEN_ALIGN is 1 (Memory.h:581-615) and is empty when EIGEN_ALIGN is 0, i.e. when EIGEN_DONT_ALIGN is defined (Memory.h:616-617, Macros.h:85-92).
